agreement_source: two independent judges (gemini, sonnet) over the same 946 datax documents: raw agreement 0.9545 on 'does this document contain PII', Cohen kappa 0.9080, judge-vs-judge F1 0.9487
notes: Baseline is the frozen champion re-scored against corrected gold: it flags 99.95% of genuinely PII-free documents. Mechanism is a data defect, not a model ceiling: 6 of 8 training corpora contain zero labelled-clean documents, so the fitted model never saw a negative.
20,714 real-world judge-asserted PII-free training documents (datax 8,499 + govdocs2 12,215) are present in 1-train but invisible to the current loader, on top of pii2's 49,997 synthetic negatives.
